symptom: A source-only verification runner exported Git directory and worktree overrides. Git commands in a temporary test fixture inherited them and changed the shared checkout's metadata instead of the fixture.
rule: The CI-red playbook requires runners and fixture subprocesses to strip all seven Git routing variables. Fixtures use fresh temporary directories; the regression injects routing only to another disposable repository and verifies its metadata remains unchanged.
check: pnpm test:git scripts/__tests__/control-plane-scope.test.ts -t 'keeps Git fixture repositories and subprocesses isolated from ambient Git routing'
